title: eCAD Electrical Domain Vocabulary v1
description: The scenarios and closed-form derivations the electrical domain adapter implements. The generic requirements schema leaves both open; the electrical adapter validates every electrical requirement and reference against this document. A scenario is a window of the one ngspice transient every case runs, so it carries only its name.

name.description: startup: the power-up sequence before the fault; steady_state: the instant the fault is commanded, with the load on; output_short: the end of the fault window.

derivation.description: Name of the independent closed-form derivation that computes the expected value from the engineering model. The value itself is computed, not typed.
